text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll be racing against Bourbon and<n>McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A little. And maybe just a tiny bit<n>scared too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What if I lose? What if I don't meet<n>everyone's
expectations? What if I<n>make everyone upset?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When I get lost in thoughts like that, I<n>can feel
myself freezing up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But if I put my hand on chest...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I get a warm feeling deep in my heart,<n>and I know
I'll be okay.
